IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: IS A NETWORK OF EDUCATION PHILANTHROPISTS DEDICATED TO LEARNING, COLLABORATING, AND TAKING COLLECTIVE ACTION TO ADVANCE EFFECTIVE, EQUITABLE, AND STRATEGIC GRANTMAKING.
IRS990.MissionDesc: AS THE LEADING NETWORK FOR EDUCATION PHILANTHROPY, GRANTMAKERS FOR EDUCATION OFFERS AN UNPARALLELED PLATFORM FOR LEARNING, COLLABORATION, AND INFLUENCE-BACKED BY FRONT-LINE SECTOR RESEARCH, EXCLUSIVE INSIGHTS AND A VIBRANT COMMUNITY OF PEERS.
IRS990.Desc: CONFERENCES AND PROGRAMS: THE CORE OF GRANTMAKERS FOR EDUCATION'S WORK WITH GRANTMAKERS REMAINS IN-PERSON AND VIRTUAL PROGRAMS AND CONVENINGS DESIGNED TO GIVE FUNDERS OPPORTUNITIES TO DELVE DEEPER INTO EDUCATIONAL ISSUES AND STRATEGIES, DISCUSS GRANTMAKING DILEMMAS, AND CONNECT WITH COLLEAGUES WORKING ON SIMILAR ISSUES. EQUITY IS INCORPORATED THROUGHOUT OUR PROGRAMMING. THIS YEAR THE ORGANIZATION OFFERED A WIDE ARRAY OF PROGRAM FORMATS COVERING A LARGE RANGE OF TOPICS OVER THE YEAR. MEMBERS WERE ABLE TO SELECT FROM ALMOST 50 OFFERINGS, IN ADDITION TO THE CONFERENCE, THAT SERVED MANY LEARNING STYLES IN A NUMBER OF VENUES. FROM TOPICAL WEBINARS, TO IN-PERSON STUDY TOURS TO ON-SITE AND VIRTUAL GATHERINGS, MEMBERS WERE ABLE TO LEARN ABOUT AND ENGAGE WITH TOPICS THAT COVERED THE EDUCATION SPECTRUM AND BEYOND.GRANTMAKERS FOR EDUCATION'S ANNUAL CONFERENCE REMAINS OUR LARGEST AND MOST POPULAR PROGRAM. THE CONFERENCE IS A DYNAMIC NATIONAL GATHERING FOR FUNDERS TO LEARN ABOUT EMERGING EDUCATION ISSUES AND EFFECTIVE EDUCATION PHILANTHROPY. THE 2024 ANNUAL CONFERENCE WAS A CELEBRATED SUCCESS, WHICH OVERALL PROVIDED A 98% SATISFACTION RATE. ALMOST 850 EDUCATION GRANTMAKERS AND EXPERTS ENGAGED IN CONVERSATIONS AND PROGRAMMING CENTERED ON THE PUBLIC PROMISE OF EDUCATION IN A VIBRANT AND INCLUSIVE MULTIRACIAL DEMOCRACY. ATTENDEES WERE ENTHUSIASTIC ABOUT LEARNING, MEETING IN PERSON AND CONNECTING WITH COLLEAGUES.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: IMPACT GROUPS: IMPACT GROUPS ARE COMMUNITIES OF MEMBERS WHO AGREE TO LEARN AND LEAD TOGETHER. GRANTMAKERS FOR EDUCATION HOSTS IMPACT GROUPS AS MEMBER-DRIVEN SPACES IN WHICH PARTICIPANTS WITH A COMMON INTEREST CAN CONNECT AND COLLABORATE AROUND A SPECIFIC TOPIC TO EXCHANGE IDEAS, SHARE AND DEVELOP STRATEGIES AND BUILD RELATIONSHIPS. FROM GRAPPLING WITH IDEAS ABOUT CRITICAL PROBLEMS TO STUDYING POTENTIAL SOLUTIONS TO TAKING ACTION WITH OTHERS, AND MORE, IMPACT GROUPS ALLOW PARTICIPANTS TO EXPLORE AND UNDERSTAND THEIR INDIVIDUAL, ORGANIZATIONAL, AND COLLECTIVE ROLE IN TACKLING THE LARGE AND COMPLEX ISSUES WITHIN OUR EDUCATION SYSTEMS.THE INFLUENCE AND IMPACT OF GRANTMAKERS FOR EDUCATION IMPACT GROUPS CONTINUES TO GROW OVER THE YEARS. IN 2024, THE OUT-OF-SCHOOL TIME IMPACT GROUP HELD OVER 20 PROGRAMS AND EVENTS, WHICH INCLUDED ALMOST 1,000 PARTICIPANTS. IN ADDITION, THEY PUBLISHED A DATABASE WITH MULTIPLE PARTNERS ON STRATEGIES TO SUPPORT A THRIVING OUT-OF-SCHOOL TIME WORKFORCE. THE POSTSECONDARY ACCESS AND ATTAINMENT IMPACT GROUP MAINTAINED REGULAR COMMUNICATION WITH ALMOST 300 MEMBER COLLEAGUES, STARTED A NEW WEBINAR SERIES AND RESEARCHED AND PUBLISHED A LANDSCAPE SCAN OF POSTSECONDARY COLLABORATIVES. IN ADDITION, GRANTMAKERS FOR EDUCATION LAUNCHED A NEW IMPACT GROUP IN 2024 ON PLAYFUL LEARNING. OTHER IMPACT GROUPS CONTINUED THEIR STRONG WORK IN BRINGING TOGETHER MINDFUL LEADERS IN THEIR AREAS OF INTEREST TO LEARN, CONNECT AND ADVANCE THE FIELD.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: MEMBER SERVICE AND STRATEGIC INITIATIVES: GRANTMAKERS FOR EDUCATION PROVIDES INDIVIDUALIZED TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE AND GUIDANCE TO HELP GRANTMAKING ORGANIZATIONS REFINE THEIR STRATEGIES AND TO CONNECT THEM WITH OTHER PEER GRANTMAKING ORGANIZATIONS FOR PEER ASSISTANCE AND COLLABORATION OPPORTUNITIES.

ProgSrvcAccomActyOtherGrp.Desc: COMMUNICATIONS AND PUBLICATIONS: THE COMMUNICATIONS AND PUBLICATIONS FUNCTION INCLUDES DEVELOPING REPORTS, CASE STUDIES AND NEWSLETTERS THAT PROMOTE DEEPER KNOWLEDGE OF EFFECTIVE GRANTMAKING PRACTICES AS WELL AS HIGHLIGHT TRENDS AND EMERGING DEVELOPMENTS IN THE FIELD. GRANTMAKERS FOR EDUCATION HAD AN ACTIVE YEAR IN COMMUNICATIONS, LAUNCHING A FEATURE TO SHOWCASE MEMBER VOICES, RELEASING PUBLICATIONS THAT HELPED GRANTMAKERS MAKE SENSE OF AND DRIVE ACTION IN THE FIELD, AND CLOSING SEASON TWO OF OUR PODCAST.MEMBER INSIGHTSMEMBER INSIGHTS IS A NEW OFFERING THIS YEAR CREATED FOR MEMBERS TO SHARE IDEAS, SUCCESSES, CHALLENGES OR LESSONS THAT CAN BUILD KNOWLEDGE, GROW OUR COMMUNITY AND STRENGTHEN THE FIELD OF EDUCATION PHILANTHROPY. THE QUARTERLY FEATURE IN OUR NEWSLETTER AND WEBSITE FEATURED FOUR MEMBERS WRITING ABOUT TOPICS THAT COVERED THE VALUE OF INVESTING IN PUBLIC EDUCATION ADVOCACY, THE POTENTIAL OF PLAYFUL LEARNING AND THE IMPORTANCE OF LEADERSHIP FOR EDUCATION EQUITY.PUBLICATIONSOVER THE YEAR, GRANTMAKERS FOR EDUCATION PRODUCED THREE PUBLICATIONS: AFTERSCHOOL AND SUMMER WORKFORCE SOLUTIONS DATABASE LANDSCAPE SCAN OF POSTSECONDARY FUNDER COLLABORATIVES GRANTMAKERS FOR EDUCATION'S TOP 10 OF 2024

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION RECOGNIZES THE EFFECT OF INCOME TAX POSITION ONLY WHEN THEY ARE MORE LIKELY THAN NOT TO BE SUSTAINED. MANAGEMENT HAS DETERMINE THAT THE ORGANIZATION HAD NO UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS THAT WOULD REQUIRE FINANCIAL STATEMENT RECOGNITION OR DISCLOSURE. THE ORGANIZATION IS NO LONGER SUBJECT TO EXAMINATIONS BY THE APPLICABLE TAXING JURISDICTIONS FOR THE PERIODS PRIOR TO 2021.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD FINANCE AND ADMINISTRATION COMMITTEE RECEIVED A COPY OF THE FORM 990 VIA EMAIL. THE FILING WAS THEN REVIEWED AND DISCUSSED WITH THE MANAGING DIRECTOR DURING A COMMITTEE MEETING. A COPY OF THE RETURN WAS MADE AVAILABLE TO THE FULL BOARD OF DIRECTORS FOR REVIEW PRIOR TO FILING AND WAS DISCUSSED DURING A BOARD MEETING IN A CONVERSATION LED BY THE BOARD TREASURER.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: BOARD AND STAFF MEMBERS COMPLETE AND SIGN A QUESTIONNAIRE ANNUALLY TO IDENTIFY ANY ACTUAL OR POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST. THE INFORMATION CONTAINED IN THIS FORM WILL DETERMINE IF ANY ACTUAL CONFLICT OF INTEREST EXISTS. EDFUNDERS POLICY REQUIRES THE BOARD TO OBTAIN DISCLOSURE OF THE FINANCIAL INTEREST AND OR ALL MATERIAL FACTS, AND TO DETERMINE (IN THE ABSENCE OF THE INTERESTED PARTY) WHETHER A CONFLICT EXISTS. EDFUNDERS POLICY OUTLINES A SET OF PROCEDURES FOR ADDRESSING ANY CONFLICTS THAT ARE DETERMINED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: AN ANNUAL REVIEW OF THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR IS CONDUCTED BY THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD. THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE CONDUCTS A COMPARATIVE EXECUTIVE SALARY REVIEW, BENCHMARKING PEER ORGANIZATIONS AND REVIEWING ORGANIZATIONAL SALARY HISTORY, AS WELL AS PERFORMANCE REVIEW FINDINGS TO DEVELOP A COMPENSATION RECOMMENDATION. THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE'S RECOMMENDATION IS PRESENTED TO THE FULL BOARD FOR FINAL APPROVAL.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAKES ITS FORM 990 AVAILABLE FOR PUBLIC INSPECTION AS REQUIRED UNDER SECTION 6104 OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE. THE RETURN IS ALSO POSTED ON GUIDESTAR.ORG AND OTHER SIMILAR TYPES OF WEBSITES. IN ADDITION, THE ORGANIZATION MAKES ITS GOVERNING DOCUMENTS AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC BY PROVIDING COPIES UPON REQUEST.
